releaseNotes:
- Sidebar update button: a new release is now detected within ~30 minutes instead of up to 6 hours. The status endpoint answers from the cache without waiting on the network, so a slow GitHub cannot hang the dashboard (7b24b9c)
- Add scripts/update-9router.sh for systemd deployments: verifies the release checksum before installing, backs up the running binary, installs atomically, and refuses a binary that will not execute (22ad9ce)

---
Update from the dashboard (sidebar button) or run `9router-go --update`.
